title: Annex A.7 - Data for AI systems
description: Working paper for Annex A.7: data management, data quality, data acquisition, data preparation, privacy.

sections.title: Data for AI systems (A.7.2)
prompts: Verify data management process across AI lifecycle.

sections.title: Data quality (A.7.3)
prompts: Verify data quality dimensions are measured (accuracy, completeness, representativeness, freshness).
Confirm acceptance thresholds and remediation paths.

sections.title: Data provenance and acquisition (A.7.4)
prompts: Confirm legal basis for data acquisition; check licensing.

sections.title: Data preparation (A.7.5)
prompts: Confirm preprocessing steps are reproducible (versioned scripts).
Sample dataset versions and verify lineage.

checklists.text: Dataset registry tracks lineage and provenance.
Preprocessing pipeline is versioned (e.g., DVC, MLflow).

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Pick a dataset and show us the lineage from raw to model-ready.
How do you handle a dataset with revoked consent?
Show us a recent PII review.
